description: The LimitStream.php file defines the LimitStream class, which is a decorator for a stream implementing the PSR-7 StreamInterface. It allows reading a subset of a stream's data by setting limits and offsets.

classes.name: LimitStream
classes.description: A decorator class implementing StreamInterface to limit reading to a specific subset of the underlying stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a LimitStream wrapping a given stream, setting the byte limit and offset.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the limited stream has been reached.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the limited subset of data.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the limited stream, respecting the limit boundaries.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the limited stream relative to its offset.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the starting offset for reading within the underlying stream.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the byte limit for reading from the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads up to a specified number of bytes from the limited stream.
